title: The evening review
idea: At the end of the day, look back honestly at what you did, without excuses and without harshness. Then adjust.
apply: Tonight, answer three questions in one line each: what did I resist, what went well, where can I improve?
remind: Review the day. Improve the next.
who: Jon, a manager who keeps repeating the same mistake.

items.x: Skipped lunch to finish a report

scenes.nar: Jon has a busy day. He snaps at a teammate, skips lunch, and helps a colleague with her pitch.
Without reflection, the same mistake repeats. He snaps on Monday, again on Wednesday, and again on Friday, and never sees the pattern.
So Jon borrows Seneca's habit. Each evening he asks three questions: what did I resist today, what went well, and where can I improve?
Within a week he notices he snaps when he is hungry. He protects his lunch break, and two weeks later the pattern is gone.
